species_search_results.Giant isopod: Two distinct NOAA-hosted video assets identified, both page-described as Bathynomus giganteus.
species_search_results.Barreleye fish: NOAA barreleye material located is a still image; no exact NOAA-hosted video confirmed.
species_search_results.Vampire squid: NOAA-hosted material identifies a still image; cited video is credited to Ocean Exploration Trust/Nautilus and is excluded.
species_search_results.Gulper eel: NOAA pelican-eel material found as a still image; no exact NOAA-hosted video confirmed.
species_search_results.Viperfish: Multiple NOAA viperfish pages found, but the identified assets are still images, not video.
species_search_results.Black dragonfish: One NOAA-hosted video found for Melanostomias melanops; page identifies it as dragonfish, but confirm common-name mapping before using as black dragonfish.
species_search_results.Colossal squid: No exact NOAA-hosted colossal-squid video confirmed. Generic giant squid material is not accepted as colossal squid.
species_search_results.Deep-sea anglerfish: Four NOAA-hosted video assets identified: Schaefer's anglerfish, Chaunacops anglerfish, goosefish, and batfish. Each needs frame-level inspection.

important_limitations: Downloaded video files pass FFprobe but species and visual uniqueness are pending frame-by-frame inspection.
SHA-256 uniqueness only catches byte-identical files, not re-encoded duplicates.
Still images are separate fallbacks and never count toward the 30-video target.
Do not mark species_review approved or approved_for_render true until representative frames are actually inspected.
The NCEI Ocean Exploration Video Portal is the preferred route for searching further exact-species segments, streams, and highlights when its search service is available.
next_gate: Inspect downloaded candidate frames and source credits, then keep searching NOAA's NCEI Video Portal and NOAA expedition video archives for the remaining exact-species candidates. Populate the 30-slot manifest only with individually verified unique video assets; keep rendering blocked until all 30 are approved and narration is present.
